headline: GB Global Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: GB Global Limited disclosed a substantial acquisition of shares under SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4), indicating a potential change in control or significant shareholding event requiring formal disclosure to the NSE.
detail: GB Global Limited filed a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 with the NSE. This regulation requires disclosure within two days of crossing the 25% shareholding threshold or upon acquiring 5% or more of voting capital in the open market. The filing indicates either an acquirer has breached a key shareholding slab or a concert party has been formed; the specific transaction details (acquirer identity, shares acquired, consideration) are contained in the detailed disclosure document.
